remarks: End-unit townhome w/maintenance-free living in Strawberry Woods, one of Stamford's most sought-after private communities. This mid-city gem is just a short stroll to train, shops, restaurants, fitness, schools & houses of worship, yet is nestled w/in 19 quiet acres featuring impeccably manicured grounds - rarely found in such a central, in-town location. Open concept living room & dining area w/wood floors & dbl-sliders warmly welcomes. Gather around the fireplace inside or entertain on the south-facing patio outside. With a rolling lawn & tree-lined border as your backyard, it truly has the best positioning. Thoughtful upgrades & quality designer touches thru-out. Kitchen: sea pearl quartzite w/gorgeous glass tile backsplash; blt-ins topped w/open shelves; high-end GE Profile/Bosch stainless (dbl-oven w/convection & new dishwasher). Powder rm w/Serena & Lily wall covering & beautiful tiled flrs. Impressive Primary, a true retreat. Step out to the balcony w/coffee & paper in hand, breathe in the fresh air & take in the tree-top views. Enjoy 2 dbl-closets & spacious ensuite w/expanded walk-in shower, extended vanity & slider window - great natural light. Guest BR w/sliders to balcony. Walk-in attic w/great possibilities & storage galore. 3rd lvl loft w/wood flrs & eaves storage - great as office, den or meditation rm. RING doorbell, freshly painted, gas heat, C/A, new water heater, main lvl W/D & att grg. Heated IG pool & clubhouse seal the deal. Seize this opportunity today!
